description:
Updates any of the following planning settings of an Atlassian team in a plan using [JSON Patch](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6902).

 *  planningStyle
 *  issueSourceId
 *  sprintLength
 *  capacity

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

*Note that "add" operations do not respect array indexes in target locations. Call the "Get Atlassian team in plan" endpoint to find out the order of array elements.*

parameters.description: The ID of the Atlassian team.
parameters.name: atlassianTeamId

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the user is not logged in.

403.description: Returned if the site has no premium edition of Jira or if the user does not have the Administer Jira global permission.

404.description: Returned if the plan or Atlassian team is not found, or the Atlassian team is not associated with the plan.

409.description: Returned if the plan is not active.
